name: Naew Ubon Run 2026
short_description: Naew Ubon Run 2026 was held on Sunday 31 May 2026 at Thung Si Mueang in Ubon Ratchathani, Thailand, over 21.1 km, 10 km and a 4 km fun run.
ai_summary: Naew Ubon Run 2026 was a road race in Mueang District, Ubon Ratchathani, in north-east Thailand, based at Thung Si Mueang. It offered a 21.1 km half marathon, a 10 km mini marathon and a 4 km fun run on 31 May 2026. Official results were published by the timing company SportStats.

faqs.question: When and where was Naew Ubon Run 2026?
faqs.answer: Naew Ubon Run 2026 took place on Sunday 31 May 2026 at Thung Si Mueang in Mueang District, Ubon Ratchathani. The half marathon started at 4.30am and the 10 km at 5.15am, according to the official results, with a 4 km fun run as well.

faqs.question: Where can I find the Naew Ubon Run 2026 results?
faqs.answer: The official results for the 21.1 km half marathon and the 10 km mini marathon are on SportStats, the timing company, where finishers can be searched by name or bib. The organiser posts race news on its Naew Ubon Run Facebook page.
